nodes.label: K-0301: Stop Switch Obstruction Prohibition
nodes.author: Codex sub-agent card_author
nodes.rationale: Safety prohibition against placing obstacles around conveyor stop switches.

nodes.label: K-0302: Restart Verification
nodes.author: Codex sub-agent card_author
nodes.rationale: Requirement to verify cause of stop and repair status before restarting after emergency/accidental stop.

nodes.label: K-0303: Conveyor Mounting Prohibition
nodes.author: Codex sub-agent card_author
nodes.rationale: Prohibition of climbing on conveyors except under specific employer-mandated safety measures.
